content.text: {"affected_statement":"L6.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"lemma","explanation":"The counterexample is valid: all E_i contain a_1, while {a_1} and, for every k≥1, {b_1,…,b_k,a_{k+1}} are distinct inclusion-minimal finite transversals. Thus the finite-blocker lemma is false, and the search-tree pruning argument does not repair it. No independent large-prime-erasure or other valid finiteness argument appears elsewhere, so the finite list b_1,…,b_s—and hence L6.2—is not established."}
